caption: Per-frame camera motion score (bold blue). The score measures high-frequency tremor in the camera path — smooth pans, orbits and zooms score near zero even when fast. Compare with the faint teal camera-speed line: high speed + low score = intentional movement. Red shading = frames above the threshold (excessive movement).

Average motion-model residual per zone (3×3 grid, absolute pixel scale — all-green means the whole frame moves like one rigid camera). Localised red zones = motion that no camera move explains: moving subjects, parallax, or AI warping artefacts.

Worst frame at t = 0.20s (frame 6, score = 0.176). Arrows = per-point optical flow: green = fits the global camera model, red = outlier (subject motion / parallax / artefact). Cyan bold arrow = global camera motion (3× scaled).
